image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Triceratops head and upper torso emerging from behind wooden planks and green foliage. The dinosaur has textured, pebbled skin, three horns (two brow, one nasal), and a parrot-like beak. The lighting is dramatic with strong shadows, suggesting an outdoor or enclosure setting.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Three prominent horns: two long brow horns projecting forward and upward above the eyes, and a shorter nasal horn on the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays two large brow horns and a smaller nasal horn. Their orientation and relative sizes match the taxonomic description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beak is parrot-like with a sharp, keratinous cutting edge.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth structure shows a distinct, curved, beak-like formation consistent with ceratopsian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is quadrupedal with columnar, elephant-like limbs.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The framing is a tight close-up on the head; the limbs and full body posture are occluded by foliage and out of frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Enormous bony frill (neck shield) extending posteriorly from the skull, with width dramatically exceeding the skull itself.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill is largely occluded by the angle and foreground foliage. Only the very base might be inferred, but its full extent and width cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Frill is solid bone with a smooth outer surface and possible epoccipital (marginal) bumps.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cannot see the frill surface due to occlusion.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is inferred to have been covered in large, hexagonal scales with possible quill-like structures along the back and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible skin on the head and neck exhibits a detailed, pebbled/scaly texture consistent with the 'hexagonal scales' description, though quills are not visible in this crop.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The eye appears slightly glassy and lacks the complex biological depth of a real animal eye, resembling a plastic model or statue. The transition between the eyelid and the eyeball is slightly soft.
The lower jaw/beak area seems to merge indistinctly with the neck/skin texture. The articulation point of the jaw is not clearly defined, looking more like a fused mass than a mechanical hinge.
The wooden planks in the upper left show slight warping and inconsistent grain direction, typical of AI-generated background elements trying to mimic perspective.
